sourceBound.boundMeaning: C bounds sup|partial_y0^r F| and sup|partial_y1^r F| on the unit torus at each fixed slow parameter.
sourceBound.proof: Apply the two-dimensional fundamental theorem of calculus at (0,0) to each pure derivative. Bound each absolute derivative by sqrt(1+derivative^2), integrate over each full unit face, and take the larger bound.

tails.lattice: All k in Z^2 with max(|k0|,|k1|)>K
proof: For the largest nonzero frequency component, r=m+4 integrations by parts give |Fhat(k)|<=C_r/((2*pi)^r*|k|max^r).
|1/(v_t.k)|<=(2+sqrt(2))*|k|max, and an output torus derivative of total order m contributes at most (2*pi)^m*|k|max^m.
Each max-norm shell n has 8n lattice points; its total is bounded by 8*(2+sqrt(2))*C_r/(2*pi)^5*n^-2.
The positive decreasing-series bound sum_(n=K+1)^infinity n^-2 <= integral_K^infinity x^-2 dx = 1/K retains every omitted mode.

finite.halfLatticeRule: k0>0 or (k0=0 and k1>0), with max(|k0|,|k1|)<=K
finite.inverseMeaning: Finite Fourier part of N^-1(F-HaarMean(F)); the Haar zero mode is returned separately and every omitted mode is bounded by the retained tails.
